    6     ret = @type

   13   def pbCalcType(user)
   14     @powerBoost = false
   15     ret = pbBaseType(user)
   16     if ret && GameData::Type.exists?(:ELECTRIC)
   17       if @battle.field.effects[PBEffects::IonDeluge] && ret == :NORMAL
   18         ret = :ELECTRIC
   19         @powerBoost = false
   20       end
   21       if user.effects[PBEffects::Electrify]
   22         ret = :ELECTRIC
   23         @powerBoost = false
   24       end
   25     end
   26     return ret
   27   end

   29   #=============================================================================
   30   # Type effectiveness calculation
   31   #=============================================================================
   32   def pbCalcTypeModSingle(moveType, defType, user, target)
   33     ret = Effectiveness.calculate(moveType, defType)
   34     if Effectiveness.ineffective_type?(moveType, defType)
   35       # Ring Target
   36       if target.hasActiveItem?(:RINGTARGET)
   37         ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   38       end
   39       # Foresight
   40       if (user.hasActiveAbility?(:SCRAPPY) || target.effects[PBEffects::Foresight]) &&
   41          defType == :GHOST
   42         ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   43       end
   44       # Miracle Eye
   45       if target.effects[PBEffects::MiracleEye] && defType == :DARK
   46         ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   47       end
   48     elsif Effectiveness.super_effective_type?(moveType, defType)
   49       # Delta Stream's weather
   50       if target.effectiveWeather == :StrongWinds && defType == :FLYING
   51         ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   52       end
   53     end
   54     # Grounded Flying-type Pokémon become susceptible to Ground moves
   55     if !target.airborne? && defType == :FLYING && moveType == :GROUND
   56       ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   57     end
   58     return ret
   59   end

   61   def pbCalcTypeMod(moveType, user, target)
   62     ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   63     return ret if !moveType
   64     return ret if moveType == :GROUND && target.pbHasType?(:FLYING) && target.hasActiveItem?(:IRONBALL)
   65     # Get effectivenesses
   66     if moveType == :SHADOW
   67       if target.shadowPokemon?
   68         ret = Effectiveness::NOT_VERY_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   69       else
   70         ret = Effectiveness::SUPER_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
   71       end
   72     else
   73       target.pbTypes(true).each do |type|
   74         ret *= pbCalcTypeModSingle(moveType, type, user, target)
   75       end
   76       ret *= 2 if target.effects[PBEffects::TarShot] && moveType == :FIRE
   77     end
   78     return ret
   79   end

   86   # Accuracy calculations for one-hit KO moves are handled elsewhere.
   87   def pbAccuracyCheck(user, target)
   88     # "Always hit" effects and "always hit" accuracy
   89     return true if target.effects[PBEffects::Telekinesis] > 0
   90     return true if target.effects[PBEffects::Minimize] && tramplesMinimize? && Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6
   91     baseAcc = pbBaseAccuracy(user, target)
   92     return true if baseAcc == 0
   93     # Calculate all multiplier effects
   94     modifiers = {}
   95     modifiers[:base_accuracy]  = baseAcc
   96     modifiers[:accuracy_stage] = user.stages[:ACCURACY]
   97     modifiers[:evasion_stage]  = target.stages[:EVASION]
   98     modifiers[:accuracy_multiplier] = 1.0
   99     modifiers[:evasion_multiplier]  = 1.0
  100     pbCalcAccuracyModifiers(user, target, modifiers)
  101     # Check if move can't miss
  102     return true if modifiers[:base_accuracy] == 0
  103     # Calculation
  104     max_stage = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
  105     accStage = [[modifiers[:accuracy_stage], -max_stage].max, max_stage].min + max_stage
  106     evaStage = [[modifiers[:evasion_stage], -max_stage].max, max_stage].min + max_stage
  107     stageMul = Battle::Battler::ACC_EVA_STAGE_MULTIPLIERS
  108     stageDiv = Battle::Battler::ACC_EVA_STAGE_DIVISORS
  109     accuracy = 100.0 * stageMul[accStage] / stageDiv[accStage]
  110     evasion  = 100.0 * stageMul[evaStage] / stageDiv[evaStage]
  111     accuracy = (accuracy * modifiers[:accuracy_multiplier]).round
  112     evasion  = (evasion  * modifiers[:evasion_multiplier]).round
  113     evasion = 1 if evasion < 1
  114     threshold = modifiers[:base_accuracy] * accuracy / evasion
  115     # Calculation
  116     r = @battle.pbRandom(100)
  117     if Settings::AFFECTION_EFFECTS && @battle.internalBattle &&
  118        target.pbOwnedByPlayer? && target.affection_level == 5 && !target.mega?
  119       return true if r < threshold - 10
  120       target.damageState.affection_missed = true if r < threshold
  121       return false
  122     end
  123     return r < threshold
  124   end

  126   def pbCalcAccuracyModifiers(user, target, modifiers)
  127     # Ability effects that alter accuracy calculation
  128     if user.abilityActive?
  129       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerAccuracyCalcFromUser(
  130         user.ability, modifiers, user, target, self, @calcType
  131       )
  132     end
  133     user.allAllies.each do |b|
  134       next if !b.abilityActive?
  135       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerAccuracyCalcFromAlly(
  136         b.ability, modifiers, user, target, self, @calcType
  137       )
  138     end
  139     if target.abilityActive? && !@battle.moldBreaker
  140       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerAccuracyCalcFromTarget(
  141         target.ability, modifiers, user, target, self, @calcType
  142       )
  143     end
  144     # Item effects that alter accuracy calculation
  145     if user.itemActive?
  146       Battle::ItemEffects.triggerAccuracyCalcFromUser(
  147         user.item, modifiers, user, target, self, @calcType
  148       )
  149     end
  150     if target.itemActive?
  151       Battle::ItemEffects.triggerAccuracyCalcFromTarget(
  152         target.item, modifiers, user, target, self, @calcType
  153       )
  154     end
  155     # Other effects, inc. ones that set accuracy_multiplier or evasion_stage to
  156     # specific values
  157     if @battle.field.effects[PBEffects::Gravity] > 0
  158       modifiers[:accuracy_multiplier] *= 5 / 3.0
  159     end
  160     if user.effects[PBEffects::MicleBerry]
  161       user.effects[PBEffects::MicleBerry] = false
  162       modifiers[:accuracy_multiplier] *= 1.2
  163     end
  164     modifiers[:evasion_stage] = 0 if target.effects[PBEffects::Foresight] && modifiers[:evasion_stage] > 0
  165     modifiers[:evasion_stage] = 0 if target.effects[PBEffects::MiracleEye] && modifiers[:evasion_stage] > 0
  166   end

  168   #=============================================================================
  169   # Critical hit check
  170   #=============================================================================
  171   # Return values:
  172   #   -1: Never a critical hit.
  173   #    0: Calculate normally.
  174   #    1: Always a critical hit.
  175   def pbCritialOverride(user, target); return 0; end
  176 
  177   # Returns whether the move will be a critical hit.
  178   def pbIsCritical?(user, target)
  179     return false if target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::LuckyChant] > 0
  180     c = 0
  181     # Ability effects that alter critical hit rate
  182     if c >= 0 && user.abilityActive?
  183       c = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerCriticalCalcFromUser(user.ability, user, target, c)
  184     end
  185     if c >= 0 && target.abilityActive? && !@battle.moldBreaker
  186       c = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerCriticalCalcFromTarget(target.ability, user, target, c)
  187     end
  188     # Item effects that alter critical hit rate
  189     if c >= 0 && user.itemActive?
  190       c = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerCriticalCalcFromUser(user.item, user, target, c)
  191     end
  192     if c >= 0 && target.itemActive?
  193       c = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerCriticalCalcFromTarget(target.item, user, target, c)
  194     end
  195     return false if c < 0
  196     # Move-specific "always/never a critical hit" effects
  197     case pbCritialOverride(user, target)
  198     when 1  then return true
  199     when -1 then return false
  200     end
  201     # Other effects
  202     return true if c > 50   # Merciless
  203     return true if user.effects[PBEffects::LaserFocus] > 0
  204     c += 1 if highCriticalRate?
  205     c += user.effects[PBEffects::FocusEnergy]
  206     c += 1 if user.inHyperMode? && @type == :SHADOW
  207     # Set up the critical hit ratios
  208     ratios = CRITICAL_HIT_RATIOS
  209     c = ratios.length - 1 if c >= ratios.length
  210     # Calculation
  211     return true if ratios[c] == 1
  212     r = @battle.pbRandom(ratios[c])
  213     return true if r == 0
  214     if r == 1 && Settings::AFFECTION_EFFECTS && @battle.internalBattle &&
  215        user.pbOwnedByPlayer? && user.affection_level == 5 && !target.mega?
  216       target.damageState.affection_critical = true
  217       return true
  218     end
  219     return false
  220   end

  223   # Damage calculation
  224   #=============================================================================
  225   def pbBaseDamage(baseDmg, user, target);              return baseDmg;    end
  226   def pbBaseDamageMultiplier(damageMult, user, target); return damageMult; end
  227   def pbModifyDamage(damageMult, user, target);         return damageMult; end

  229   def pbGetAttackStats(user, target)
  230     return user.spatk, user.stages[:SPECIAL_ATTACK] + Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM if specialMove?
  231     return user.attack, user.stages[:ATTACK] + Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
  232   end
  233 
  234   def pbGetDefenseStats(user, target)
  235     return target.spdef, target.stages[:SPECIAL_DEFENSE] + Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM if specialMove?
  236     return target.defense, target.stages[:DEFENSE] + Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
  237   end

  239   def pbCalcDamage(user, target, numTargets = 1)
  240     return if statusMove?
  241     if target.damageState.disguise || target.damageState.iceFace
  242       target.damageState.calcDamage = 1
  243       return
  244     end
  245     max_stage = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
  246     stageMul = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MULTIPLIERS
  247     stageDiv = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_DIVISORS
  248     # Get the move's type
  249     type = @calcType   # nil is treated as physical
  250     # Calculate whether this hit deals critical damage
  251     target.damageState.critical = pbIsCritical?(user, target)
  252     # Calcuate base power of move
  253     baseDmg = pbBaseDamage(@power, user, target)
  254     # Calculate user's attack stat
  255     atk, atkStage = pbGetAttackStats(user, target)
  256     if !target.hasActiveAbility?(:UNAWARE) || @battle.moldBreaker
  257       atkStage = max_stage if target.damageState.critical && atkStage < max_stage
  258       atk = (atk.to_f * stageMul[atkStage] / stageDiv[atkStage]).floor
  259     end
  260     # Calculate target's defense stat
  261     defense, defStage = pbGetDefenseStats(user, target)
  262     if !user.hasActiveAbility?(:UNAWARE)
  263       defStage = max_stage if target.damageState.critical && defStage > max_stage
  264       defense = (defense.to_f * stageMul[defStage] / stageDiv[defStage]).floor
  265     end
  266     # Calculate all multiplier effects
  267     multipliers = {
  268       :power_multiplier        => 1.0,
  269       :attack_multiplier       => 1.0,
  270       :defense_multiplier      => 1.0,
  271       :final_damage_multiplier => 1.0
  272     }
  273     pbCalcDamageMultipliers(user, target, numTargets, type, baseDmg, multipliers)
  274     # Main damage calculation
  275     baseDmg = [(baseDmg * multipliers[:power_multiplier]).round, 1].max
  276     atk     = [(atk     * multipliers[:attack_multiplier]).round, 1].max
  277     defense = [(defense * multipliers[:defense_multiplier]).round, 1].max
  278     damage  = ((((2.0 * user.level / 5) + 2).floor * baseDmg * atk / defense).floor / 50).floor + 2
  279     damage  = [(damage * multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier]).round, 1].max
  280     target.damageState.calcDamage = damage
  281   end

  283   def pbCalcDamageMultipliers(user, target, numTargets, type, baseDmg, multipliers)
  284     # Global abilities
  285     if (@battle.pbCheckGlobalAbility(:DARKAURA) && type == :DARK) ||
  286        (@battle.pbCheckGlobalAbility(:FAIRYAURA) && type == :FAIRY)
  287       if @battle.pbCheckGlobalAbility(:AURABREAK)
  288         multipliers[:power_multiplier] *= 3 / 4.0
  289       else
  290         multipliers[:power_multiplier] *= 4 / 3.0
  291       end
  292     end
  293     # Ability effects that alter damage
  294     if user.abilityActive?
  295       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerDamageCalcFromUser(
  296         user.ability, user, target, self, multipliers, baseDmg, type
  297       )
  298     end
  299     if !@battle.moldBreaker
  300       # NOTE: It's odd that the user's Mold Breaker prevents its partner's
  301       #       beneficial abilities (i.e. Flower Gift boosting Atk), but that's
  302       #       how it works.
  303       user.allAllies.each do |b|
  304         next if !b.abilityActive?
  305         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerDamageCalcFromAlly(
  306           b.ability, user, target, self, multipliers, baseDmg, type
  307         )
  308       end
  309       if target.abilityActive?
  310         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerDamageCalcFromTarget(
  311           target.ability, user, target, self, multipliers, baseDmg, type
  312         )
  313       end
  314     end
  315     if target.abilityActive?
  316       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerDamageCalcFromTargetNonIgnorable(
  317         target.ability, user, target, self, multipliers, baseDmg, type
  318       )
  319     end
  320     if !@battle.moldBreaker
  321       target.allAllies.each do |b|
  322         next if !b.abilityActive?
  323         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerDamageCalcFromTargetAlly(
  324           b.ability, user, target, self, multipliers, baseDmg, type
  325         )
  326       end
  327     end
  328     # Item effects that alter damage
  329     if user.itemActive?
  330       Battle::ItemEffects.triggerDamageCalcFromUser(
  331         user.item, user, target, self, multipliers, baseDmg, type
  332       )
  333     end
  334     if target.itemActive?
  335       Battle::ItemEffects.triggerDamageCalcFromTarget(
  336         target.item, user, target, self, multipliers, baseDmg, type
  337       )
  338     end
  339     # Parental Bond's second attack
  340     if user.effects[PBEffects::ParentalBond] == 1
  341       multipliers[:power_multiplier] /= (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7) ? 4 : 2
  342     end
  343     # Other
  344     if user.effects[PBEffects::MeFirst]
  345       multipliers[:power_multiplier] *= 1.5
  346     end
  347     if user.effects[PBEffects::HelpingHand] && !self.is_a?(Battle::Move::Confusion)
  348       multipliers[:power_multiplier] *= 1.5
  349     end
  350     if user.effects[PBEffects::Charge] > 0 && type == :ELECTRIC
  351       multipliers[:power_multiplier] *= 2
  352     end
  353     # Mud Sport
  354     if type == :ELECTRIC
  355       if @battle.allBattlers.any? { |b| b.effects[PBEffects::MudSport] }
  356         multipliers[:power_multiplier] /= 3
  357       end
  358       if @battle.field.effects[PBEffects::MudSportField] > 0
  359         multipliers[:power_multiplier] /= 3
  360       end
  361     end
  362     # Water Sport
  363     if type == :FIRE
  364       if @battle.allBattlers.any? { |b| b.effects[PBEffects::WaterSport] }
  365         multipliers[:power_multiplier] /= 3
  366       end
  367       if @battle.field.effects[PBEffects::WaterSportField] > 0
  368         multipliers[:power_multiplier] /= 3
  369       end
  370     end
  371     # Terrain moves
  372     terrain_multiplier = (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 8) ? 1.3 : 1.5
  373     case @battle.field.terrain
  374     when :Electric
  375       multipliers[:power_multiplier] *= terrain_multiplier if type == :ELECTRIC && user.affectedByTerrain?
  376     when :Grassy
  377       multipliers[:power_multiplier] *= terrain_multiplier if type == :GRASS && user.affectedByTerrain?
  378     when :Psychic
  379       multipliers[:power_multiplier] *= terrain_multiplier if type == :PSYCHIC && user.affectedByTerrain?
  380     when :Misty
  381       multipliers[:power_multiplier] /= 2 if type == :DRAGON && target.affectedByTerrain?
  382     end
  383     # Badge multipliers
  384     if @battle.internalBattle
  385       if user.pbOwnedByPlayer?
  386         if physicalMove? && @battle.pbPlayer.badge_count >= Settings::NUM_BADGES_BOOST_ATTACK
  387           multipliers[:attack_multiplier] *= 1.1
  388         elsif specialMove? && @battle.pbPlayer.badge_count >= Settings::NUM_BADGES_BOOST_SPATK
  389           multipliers[:attack_multiplier] *= 1.1
  390         end
  391       end
  392       if target.pbOwnedByPlayer?
  393         if physicalMove? && @battle.pbPlayer.badge_count >= Settings::NUM_BADGES_BOOST_DEFENSE
  394           multipliers[:defense_multiplier] *= 1.1
  395         elsif specialMove? && @battle.pbPlayer.badge_count >= Settings::NUM_BADGES_BOOST_SPDEF
  396           multipliers[:defense_multiplier] *= 1.1
  397         end
  398       end
  399     end
  400     # Multi-targeting attacks
  401     multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 0.75 if numTargets > 1
  402     # Weather
  403     case user.effectiveWeather
  404     when :Sun, :HarshSun
  405       case type
  406       when :FIRE
  407         multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 1.5
  408       when :WATER
  409         multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] /= 2
  410       end
  411     when :Rain, :HeavyRain
  412       case type
  413       when :FIRE
  414         multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] /= 2
  415       when :WATER
  416         multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 1.5
  417       end
  418     when :Sandstorm
  419       if target.pbHasType?(:ROCK) && specialMove? && @function_code != "UseTargetDefenseInsteadOfTargetSpDef"
  420         multipliers[:defense_multiplier] *= 1.5
  421       end
  422     when :ShadowSky
  423       multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 1.5 if type == :SHADOW
  424     end
  425     # Critical hits
  426     if target.damageState.critical
  427       if Settings::NEW_CRITICAL_HIT_RATE_MECHANICS
  428         multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 1.5
  429       else
  430         multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 2
  431       end
  432     end
  433     # Random variance
  434     if !self.is_a?(Battle::Move::Confusion)
  435       random = 85 + @battle.pbRandom(16)
  436       multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= random / 100.0
  437     end
  438     # STAB
  439     if type && user.pbHasType?(type)
  440       if user.hasActiveAbility?(:ADAPTABILITY)
  441         multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 2
  442       else
  443         multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 1.5
  444       end
  445     end
  446     # Type effectiveness
  447     multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= target.damageState.typeMod
  448     # Burn
  449     if user.status == :BURN && physicalMove? && damageReducedByBurn? &&
  450        !user.hasActiveAbility?(:GUTS)
  451       multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] /= 2
  452     end
  453     # Aurora Veil, Reflect, Light Screen
  454     if !ignoresReflect? && !target.damageState.critical &&
  455        !user.hasActiveAbility?(:INFILTRATOR)
  456       if target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::AuroraVeil] > 0
  457         if @battle.pbSideBattlerCount(target) > 1
  458           multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 2 / 3.0
  459         else
  460           multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] /= 2
  461         end
  462       elsif target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Reflect] > 0 && physicalMove?
  463         if @battle.pbSideBattlerCount(target) > 1
  464           multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 2 / 3.0
  465         else
  466           multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] /= 2
  467         end
  468       elsif target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::LightScreen] > 0 && specialMove?
  469         if @battle.pbSideBattlerCount(target) > 1
  470           multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 2 / 3.0
  471         else
  472           multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] /= 2
  473         end
  474       end
  475     end
  476     # Minimize
  477     if target.effects[PBEffects::Minimize] && tramplesMinimize?
  478       multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 2
  479     end
  480     # Move-specific base damage modifiers
  481     multipliers[:power_multiplier] = pbBaseDamageMultiplier(multipliers[:power_multiplier], user, target)
  482     # Move-specific final damage modifiers
  483     multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] = pbModifyDamage(multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier], user, target)
  484   end

  489   def pbAdditionalEffectChance(user, target, effectChance = 0)
  490     return 0 if target.hasActiveAbility?(:SHIELDDUST) && !@battle.moldBreaker
  491     ret = (effectChance > 0) ? effectChance : @addlEffect
  492     return ret if ret > 100
  493     if (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6 || @function_code != "EffectDependsOnEnvironment") &&
  494        (user.hasActiveAbility?(:SERENEGRACE) || user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Rainbow] > 0)
  495       ret *= 2
  496     end
  497     ret = 100 if $DEBUG && Input.press?(Input::CTRL)
  498     return ret
  499   end

  501   # NOTE: Flinching caused by a move's effect is applied in that move's code,
  502   #       not here.
  503   def pbFlinchChance(user, target)
  504     return 0 if flinchingMove?
  505     return 0 if target.hasActiveAbility?(:SHIELDDUST) && !@battle.moldBreaker
  506     ret = 0
  507     if user.hasActiveAbility?(:STENCH, true) ||
  508        user.hasActiveItem?([:KINGSROCK, :RAZORFANG], true)
  509       ret = 10
  510     end
  511     ret *= 2 if user.hasActiveAbility?(:SERENEGRACE) ||
  512                 user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Rainbow] > 0
  513     return ret
  514   end
